rules.disease: pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect
rules.sentence: Pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect (PAVSD) is one of the cyanotic congenital heart diseases and occurs due to the underdevelopment or maldevelopment of the right ventricular outflow tract and atresia of the pulmonary valve and trunk.

rules.disease: pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect
rules.sentence: This condition also involves overriding the aorta and a large ventricular septal defect.[1]
Whether it is a different entity or a severe form of tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) is still controversial, but there is no denying the occurrence of PAVSD.
